firstActions: During authorized execution, inspect repository instructions, relevant accepted task/status, working diff, installed stack, and project scripts; preserve unrelated work.
Reproduce save followed by a fresh read and reload using controlled local data. Trace every affected caller through entry, validation, authorization, logic, write, response, read, and UI.
Find the first boundary whose observed result violates the accepted persistence contract. Compare a working path and test one supported hypothesis with the smallest failing behavioral check.
Patch that root cause with the existing project pattern, update affected producers/consumers, and rerun the same real path. Gather new evidence if the hypothesis fails.

authorization.alreadyAuthorized: The actionable request authorizes scoped reversible local repair and local verification through all affected layers. Preserve that authorization through specialist handoffs; do not ask for implementation approval again.
authorization.otherBoundaries: Secret access, destructive actions, production migrations, pushing, or scope expansion require their own authorization if they become necessary. The supplied case needs no secrets or live data.

requiredEvidence: The focused regression reproduces disappearance before the fix and passes afterward; an HTTP 200 alone is insufficient.
A real local request saves a controlled note; an independent read of the affected persistent state and a fresh application read confirm the same value.
The real browser saves the note, reloads, and observes the retained value using ui-validation; retain the existing screen behavior.
Exercise relevant existing validation/authorization and write-failure behavior where affected, including safe failure rather than false success if persistence fails.
Run the smallest project-native static/build checks covering touched code and relevant existing tests.
verification.evidenceRecord: Record concrete targets, commands/scenarios, observed state, and remaining gaps in the canonical task/delivery record. Local proof does not establish hosted CI or production behavior.

cases.stopCondition: Finish when the accepted save-and-reload behavior has focused automated, persistent-state, and local runtime/browser proof and the existing evidence record is reconciled. Stop before deployment or commit. If a required local environment is unavailable, finish reachable work and identify the exact unverified gate rather than claiming completion.
unresolved: The framework, storage technology, root cause, project commands, and repository path are not specified by this synthetic case; resolve them from the actual repository without guessing.
